subject: Mutual Action Plan: CoreTech evaluation & CTO sponsorship
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@coretech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: proposal, roles, and sponsor request

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the productive kickoff earlier today. Per our call, we'd like to put a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) on paper so we have aligned milestones, clear owners, and the right executive sponsor on your side to unblock decisions during the evaluation.

Attached is a first-pass MAP (CoreTech_MAP_Draft.xlsx) and a short evaluation guide we typically share with engineering-led evals. High-level asks from our side: 
- Can you confirm who will be the executive sponsor for the program (VP/CTO-level)?
- Please review the milestones and owners in the attached MAP and flag any missing stakeholders.
- Confirm a target close date window (we suggested end of Q3 but we can tighten depending on your procurement cycle).

Key roles we propose:
- Redwood AE (me) — program owner for execution & roadmap alignment
- Redwood Solutions Architect (Marcus) — technical deep-dive & PoC support
- Customer Success (Marissa) — onboarding, eval success criteria, and SLA discussions
- Executive escalation (we'd like a named sponsor on your side to help with priority decisions)

Suggested initial timeline (draft):
- Week 0: executive sponsor intro & alignment call
- Weeks 1–3: technical PoC + integration checks
- Weeks 4–6: performance/QA, cost/perf tuning, and security sign-off
- Week 7: final exec review and purchase/commit decision

I'm copying Marcus and Marissa here so they can introduce themselves to your team and help capture technical and success criteria. If you prefer a slightly different cadence (shorter/longer), tell us and we'll adapt the MAP.

Attachments: CoreTech_MAP_Draft.xlsx (MAP with milestones/owners)

Looking forward — can you loop in your sponsor and suggest 2 times for a 30-minute executive alignment call?

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Vanessa —

Thanks for the MAP and the clear next steps. Quick answers:
- Our CTO, Mira Patel, will act as the executive sponsor for this evaluation. I copied her here.
- Suggested timeline looks fine; our internal procurement window might push a final decision slightly into early Q4 unless we can accelerate some of the legal items.

A couple of questions from our side before we lock dates:
1) Can you share the evaluation criteria you typically use for production readiness (latency/throughput thresholds, SLOs, and data residency assumptions)?
2) Are there any pre-approved SOC 2 / security docs we should expect to request during weeks 2–4?

I've attached a short doc our engineering manager asked for: CoreTech_Eval_Guide.pdf (internal). I can do a 30-minute sponsor intro call next Tue or Wed (I added a calendar placeholder: https://cal.coretech.io/meet/ctosponsor-30m). Either of those days works for Mira.

Liam O'Neill

Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: proposal, roles, and sponsor request

Hi Liam and Mira —

Great to have Mira on the thread — welcome, and thank you for agreeing to sponsor. To get ahead of the questions you raised, I've summarized the evaluation checklist and escalation path below, and attached a Roles & Milestones doc (MAP_RolesMilestones_v1.docx) with owners pre-filled:

Evaluation checklist (short):
- Performance targets: p95 latency <= 250ms for 1k concurrent sessions (we'll scope PoC to representative traffic)
- Cost benchmarking: token throughput and projected monthly cost at target QPS
- Security: SOC 2 Type II docs, data-at-rest encryption, and customer-managed KMS options
- Observability: per-request tracing and token-level cost breakdown in the console

Escalation & exec alignment playbook:
- Day-to-day blockers -> Marcus (Solutions Architect)
- Contract/procurement blockers -> Marissa (CS) and Vanessa (AE)
- Technical escalations requiring priority infra or product changes -> Rishi (Head, Strategic Accounts) + direct exec-to-exec thread with Mira

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Executive sponsor intro call (30m) — Mira + Liam + Vanessa + Rishi — propose Tue 26 May or Wed 27 May; use Liam's calendar link to lock a slot.
2) Marcus to kick off the PoC plan directly with your engineering manager (Marcus will send an invite once sponsor call is scheduled).
3) Marissa to share a short success criteria doc and procurement checklist for your procurement team.

Attachments: MAP_RolesMilestones_v1.docx (owners + dates filled)

If this looks good, Mira, can you confirm Tue/Wed next week for the sponsor intro? We aim to have sponsor alignment within 5 business days of scheduling so decisions during the PoC can move quickly.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
